title: Disney agrees to hire the majority of Character.AI’s workforce | TechCrunch
summary: A legal filing spotted by Bloomberg revealed more details about the agreement between Character.AI and Disney, with Disney agreeing to make employment offers to at least 60 Character.AI employees — the majority of the workforce — paying them an estimated $60 million…
